writing.overall_comment: The document is semantically strong and well-organized as a reference, but it is less actionable and depends heavily on external examples that are not shown in the SKILL.md.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately capture a comprehensive design-pattern skill covering GoF, architectural, modern patterns, SOLID, anti-patterns, and review use cases.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: Concrete examples and failure paths are largely deferred to an external reference, and the embedded pattern list contains no worked examples or edge-case explanations.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: The skill provides useful triggers, checklists, and quick-reference tables, but it lacks explicit step-by-step procedures for selecting, applying, or validating patterns.

suggestions: Add one worked example and edge-case/failure explanation per pattern directly in the embedded pattern list instead of deferring concrete examples to the external reference.
Add an explicit step-by-step procedure near the existing triggers or checklists for selecting the appropriate pattern based on input conditions and constraints.
Add an explicit apply-and-validate procedure alongside each pattern or in the quick-reference tables that specifies how to instantiate the pattern and verify correctness against its edge cases.
